prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
All failures from checklist will be annotated under section titled "Needs Improvement"
3. Record the exact ISTC 667 quizcode on the line item for the failure.
4. Mention whether or not the item was functional and whether or not the item was provided.
5. Note the location (room number →[where in the room]) of the failure
6. Note the ART when applicable
7. Recommend how the failure is resolved either by fix or removal of item.
8. Once the fixes are done, re-do the inspection
9. Record the "Ready Saleable" re-inspection test code along with the snip of proof.
10. Only after the "Ready Saleable" inspection, add the item to the "Needs Repair" section which is the section that the Army will assess for final repairs

# How to modify the data for the inspection checklist

Add a new section for Needs Repair by
